intros t a i l.
split.
- intros [Hlive Hall]. unfold P_all_live in Hall.
  intro k. intros Hk0 Hk.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec k 0) as [Hkz | Hkz].
  + rewrite Hkz. rewrite nth_zero. exact Hlive.
  + pose proof (length_cons a l) as Hlen.
    pose proof (length_pos l) as Hlenpos.
    destruct (nth_cons k a l) as [_ Hnth2]; [lia |].
    pose proof (Hnth2 Hkz) as Heq.
    rewrite Heq.
    apply (Hall (k - 1)%Z); lia.
- intros Hall. unfold P_all_live in Hall.
  pose proof (length_pos l) as Hlenpos.
  split.
  + rewrite <- (nth_zero l a).
    apply (Hall 0%Z); [lia | rewrite length_cons; lia].
  + intro k. intros Hk0 Hk.
    pose proof (length_cons a l) as Hlen.
    assert (Hk1 : (k + 1 - 1)%Z = k) by lia.
    assert (Hkne : (k + 1)%Z <> 0%Z) by lia.
    destruct (nth_cons (k + 1)%Z a l) as [_ Hnth2]; [lia |].
    pose proof (Hnth2 Hkne) as Heq0.
    rewrite Hk1 in Heq0.
    rewrite <- Heq0.
    apply (Hall (k + 1)%Z); lia.

intros t a l.
split.
- intros [Ha Hl] i Hi Hlen.
  pose proof (length_pos l) as Hlp.
  rewrite length_cons in Hlen.
  assert (Hb : (0 <= i)%Z /\ (i <= list.Length.length l)%Z) by lia.
  destruct (nth_cons i a l Hb) as [H0 H1].
  assert (Hcase : i = 0%Z \/ i <> 0%Z) by lia.
  destruct Hcase as [Heq|Hne].
  + rewrite (H0 Heq). exact Ha.
  + rewrite (H1 Hne). apply Hl; lia.
- intros Hall. split.
  + assert (Hb : (0 < list.Length.length (Init.Datatypes.cons a l))%Z).
    { pose proof (length_pos l) as Hlp. rewrite length_cons. lia. }
    assert (H0le : (0 <= 0)%Z) by lia.
    specialize (Hall 0%Z H0le Hb).
    rewrite nth_zero in Hall. exact Hall.
  + intros i Hi Hlen.
    pose proof (length_pos l) as Hlp.
    assert (Hlen' : (i + 1 < list.Length.length (Init.Datatypes.cons a l))%Z).
    { rewrite length_cons. lia. }
    assert (Hb : (0 <= i + 1)%Z /\ (i + 1 <= list.Length.length l)%Z).
    { rewrite length_cons in Hlen'. lia. }
    assert (Hne : ~ ((i + 1)%Z = 0%Z)) by lia.
    destruct (nth_cons (i+1)%Z a l Hb) as [H0 H1].
    assert (Hle : (0 <= i + 1)%Z) by lia.
    specialize (Hall (i+1)%Z Hle Hlen').
    rewrite (H1 Hne) in Hall.
    replace ((i+1-1)%Z) with i%Z in Hall by lia.
    exact Hall.
